title: chelidonium japonicum f. lanceolatum
intro: Chelidonium japonicum f. lanceolatum, commonly known as Japanese celandine, is a variety of the Celandine plant native to East Asia. As a medicinal herb, it has been used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems, thanks to its reported health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Japanese celandine include stimulating digestion, reducing fever, and relieving pain, making it a popular natural remedy in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Chelidonium japonicum f. lanceolatum include alkaloids like chelidonine and chelerythrine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
